rows.name: N01
rows.cue: still leaving the dinner table early
rows.purpose: Walks away from the dinner table holding abdomen while husband stays seated; revised take visibly completes the exit action.

rows.name: N02
rows.purpose: The friend greets her warmly. The woman gives a polite strained smile and a small nod, concealing discomfort. No talking.

rows.name: N03
rows.purpose: She stops working, draws her knees inward slightly, presses a palm against her abdomen and exhales with a visibly tense uncomfortable expression. No speaking.

rows.name: N05
rows.cue: But GLP-1s slow those contractions down
rows.purpose: Animate a gentle peristaltic contraction traveling down the isolated longitudinal digestive smooth-muscle segment; its forward wave progressively slows, and the contents drift more slowly. No solid blockage, medical illustration only.

rows.name: N06
rows.cue: food, waste, gas with nowhere to go
rows.purpose: Animate the curved digestive lumen cutaway with food contents moving very slowly and several gas bubbles accumulating gently among contents. No bursting, obstruction or injury. Medical illustration only.

rows.name: N04
rows.cue: One night I was up late scrolling
rows.purpose: She scrolls her phone with her thumb, pauses to read with concentrated curiosity. Phone back stays toward camera.

rows.name: N07
rows.cue: I'd tried the celery juice thing
rows.exit_cue: But she said it doesn't work
rows.purpose: She tips the glass and pours the remaining celery juice into the sink, then lowers the empty glass with a disappointed look. Realistic continuous fluid stream, no talking.

rows.name: N08
rows.cue: only one I could find with all three
rows.purpose: Mature hands lift the white lid off the unbranded glass jar, revealing the same small dark forest-green heart-shaped gummies. Preserve exact gummy size, shape and color. No pouring or eating.

rows.name: N09
rows.cue: and I'm not mapping my day
rows.exit_cue: So if you're on a GLP-1
rows.purpose: She shares a natural relaxed laugh with her husband on the patio, then settles back comfortably. Small genuine expression and hand movement; no exaggerated motion.
